examples.en: A warning light came on on the instrument panel.

examples.ko: 차 계기판을 보니 기름이 거의 없어요.
examples.en: Looking at the car's gauges, there's almost no fuel.
The speed on the gauge went over 100.
There are so many instrument panels in an airplane cockpit.

examples.ko: 계기판 불이 안 들어와서 정비소에 갔어요.
examples.en: The instrument panel lights wouldn't turn on, so I went to the repair shop.

examples.ko: 운전할 때는 계기판 확인을 자주 하세요.
examples.en: Check the instrument panel often when you drive.

explain: 자동차뿐 아니라 비행기나 기계에도 쓰는 말이에요. 자동차에서 '대시보드'는 앞좌석 앞 판 전체를 가리키기도 해서 계기판과 약간 달라요.

phrases.en: I often look at the instrument panel when I drive.
phrases.nuance_ko: 속도나 기름 양을 살필 때 쓰는 가장 흔한 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the most common phrase for checking speed or fuel level.

phrases.en: The instrument panel is broken, so I can't tell my speed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 계기판이 제대로 작동하지 않을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it when the panel isn't working properly.

phrases.en: A strange sign showed up on the instrument panel.
phrases.nuance_ko: 경고등이나 글자가 화면에 나타날 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it when a warning light or text appears on the display.
phrases.en_equiv: to show up on the dashboard

explain_en: It is used not only for cars but also for airplanes and machines. In a car, '대시보드' (dashboard) can refer to the whole panel in front of the front seats, so it differs slightly from '계기판'.

examples.ko: 명절에 큰 교자상을 펴고 음식을 차렸어요.
examples.en: On the holiday, we set out a large table and laid out the food.

examples.ko: 교자상 위에 전과 나물을 가득 놓았어요.
examples.en: We filled the table with pancakes and seasoned vegetables.

examples.ko: 손님이 많아서 교자상 두 개를 붙였어요.
examples.en: There were many guests, so we put two large tables together.
My grandmother's house has a large dining table.

examples.ko: 교자상 앞에 둘러앉아 함께 밥을 먹었어요.
examples.en: We sat around the large table and ate together.

examples.ko: 잔치 때는 교자상에 음식을 푸짐하게 차려요.
examples.en: At feasts, people lay out plenty of food on the large table.

explain: 평소 혼자 먹는 작은 '밥상'과 달리, 여러 사람이 둘러앉는 큰 상으로 명절이나 잔치, 손님맞이에서 자주 나와요. 집에서 일상적으로 쓰는 말이라기보다 그런 행사 이야기에서 들어요.

phrases.en: Guests came, so we set out the banquet table.
phrases.nuance_ko: '교자상'에 음식을 한가득 준비한다는 뜻으로, 손님맞이나 명절에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means setting out a lot of food on the table, for guests or holidays.

phrases.en: The whole family sat around the banquet table and ate.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여러 사람이 큰 상 주변에 함께 앉는 모습을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes many people sitting together around a big table.
phrases.en_equiv: to sit around the banquet table

phrases.en: We set up the banquet table in the middle of the room.
phrases.nuance_ko: 접이식 상을 펴서 놓는다는 느낌으로 써요. 먹기 전에 준비하는 장면에서 들어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Gives the feel of unfolding a table and putting it down, as you prepare to eat.
phrases.en_equiv: to set up the banquet table

explain_en: Unlike the small '밥상' used for an everyday meal, it is a large table for several people to sit around, often seen at holidays, feasts and when hosting guests. You hear it more in talk about such occasions than as an everyday household word.

examples.en: At home I use a desktop, not a laptop.

examples.ko: 데스크톱이 너무 느려서 새로 사고 싶어요.
examples.en: My desktop is too slow, so I want to buy a new one.
The desktop at the office has a big screen.
I play games on a high-performance desktop.
A desktop is hard to carry around.
I got a desktop that a friend used to use, at a low price.

explain: '데스크톱'은 책상 위에 두고 쓰는 컴퓨터예요. 표준 표기는 '데스크톱'이지만 '데스크탑'이라고 쓰는 사람도 많아요. 들고 다니는 컴퓨터는 '노트북'이라고 불러요.

phrases.en: There is a desktop computer at the office.
phrases.nuance_ko: '컴퓨터'를 붙여 더 분명하게 말할 때 써요.

phrases.en: I play games on my desktop.
phrases.nuance_ko: 표준 표기는 '데스크톱'이지만 이렇게 쓰는 사람도 많아요.
phrases.nuance_en: A very common variant spelling of 데스크톱.

phrases.en: This app also has a desktop version.
phrases.nuance_ko: 휴대폰 앱이 아닌 컴퓨터용을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the computer version rather than the phone app.

explain_en: 데스크톱 is a computer you keep on a desk. The standard spelling is 데스크톱, but many people write 데스크탑. A computer you carry around is called 노트북.

examples.en: I applied to have a dashcam installed on my new car.
Fitting the tires takes about thirty minutes.
Be sure to check whether the helmet is on.
The parts have been fitted onto the machine.
The installation method is in the manual.
Installing the safety device has become mandatory.

explain: 보통 '장착하다', '장착되다'로 더 자주 써요. 명사 장착은 '타이어 장착', '장착 완료'처럼 다른 말 앞뒤에 붙여 말해요. 일상에서는 '달다', '끼우다'가 더 쉬운 말이에요.

phrases.nuance_ko: 작업이 끝났다는 알림에서 자주 보는 짧은 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A short phrase often seen in notices that the work is finished.

phrases.en: How much is the tire fitting fee?
phrases.nuance_ko: 설치하는 데 드는 돈을 물을 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing used to ask about the cost of installing something.

phrases.en: The installation takes about an hour.
phrases.nuance_ko: 설치에 걸리는 시간을 말할 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing used to talk about how long installation takes.

explain_en: It is more often used as the verbs '장착하다' and '장착되다'. As a noun it attaches to other words, as in '타이어 장착' or '장착 완료'. In everyday speech '달다' and '끼우다' are the easier words.

examples.ko: 동전 투입구에 백 원짜리 동전을 넣어 보세요.
examples.en: Try putting a 100-won coin into the coin slot.

examples.ko: 이 자판기는 투입구가 막혀서 돈이 안 들어가요.
examples.en: The slot on this vending machine is blocked, so money won't go in.

examples.ko: 재활용 쓰레기 투입구는 건물 뒤쪽에 있어요.
examples.en: The recycling drop is at the back of the building.
I put the letter in through the slot, but it didn't drop.

examples.ko: 음식물 쓰레기 투입구 뚜껑이 고장 났어요.
examples.en: The lid of the food waste drop is broken.

examples.ko: 지폐 투입구가 너무 좁아서 자꾸 걸려요.
examples.en: The bill slot is so narrow that bills keep getting stuck.

explain: 동전, 카드, 쓰레기처럼 기계나 통에 무언가를 넣는 구멍에 써요. 반대로 물건이 나오는 곳은 '배출구'나 '나오는 곳'이라고 해요. 앞에 무엇을 넣는지 붙여서 '동전 투입구'처럼 많이 말해요.

phrases.nuance_ko: '투입구' 앞에 넣는 것을 붙여서 어떤 구멍인지 분명하게 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Putting what goes in before 투입구 makes clear which slot you mean.

phrases.example: 지폐 투입구에 돈을 넣었는데 다시 나왔어요.
phrases.en: I put money in the bill slot, but it came back out.
phrases.nuance_ko: 자판기나 기계에서 종이돈을 넣는 곳을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the place in a vending machine or other machine where you insert paper money.

phrases.en: Please put your card into the slot.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기계 사용법을 안내할 때 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common phrase in instructions for using a machine.

explain_en: It is the opening where you put something into a machine or bin, such as coins, cards or trash. The place where things come out is called '배출구' or simply '나오는 곳'. People usually add what goes in first, as in '동전 투입구'.

examples.en: In old offices, people sent documents by fax.

examples.ko: 팩시밀리가 고장 나서 서류를 못 받았어요.
examples.en: The fax machine broke, so I couldn't receive the documents.

examples.ko: 요즘은 팩시밀리 대신 이메일을 많이 써요.
examples.en: These days people use email instead of fax a lot.

examples.ko: 이 팩시밀리는 번호를 누르면 바로 전송돼요.
examples.en: This fax machine sends right away once you dial the number.
I went to send a fax to the bank.
The office fax machine has run out of paper.

explain: 보통은 줄여서 '팩스'라고 해요. '팩스를 보내다/받다'처럼 말하고, '팩시밀리'는 글이나 기계 이름을 정확히 말할 때 더 어울려요.

phrases.en: Please send the documents by fax.
phrases.nuance_ko: '팩시밀리'의 줄임말로, 일상에서는 이 말을 훨씬 더 많이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The short form of 팩시밀리, used much more often in daily life.

phrases.en: Please tell me the fax number.
phrases.nuance_ko: 회사나 관공서와 연락할 때 자주 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used when contacting companies or government offices.

phrases.en: I received a fax this morning.
phrases.nuance_en: The opposite is 팩스를 보내다 for sending one.

explain_en: People usually shorten it to '팩스'. You say '팩스를 보내다/받다' (send/receive a fax), and '팩시밀리' fits better in writing or when naming the machine formally.
